1.consolidated_definition: inform. Que escribe publicaciones para formato blog. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente.Véase bloguero. Ambas compañías tienen en sus nóminas a empresarios, editores y bloggers que monitorean afanosamente los ámbitos del cambio tecnológico, la moda y patrones de consumo al detal (El Nuevo Día, 01-10-2006)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Informal term for a writer who produces content for blogs. Raw anglicism, often used. See blogger. Both companies have entrepreneurs, editors, and bloggers on their payroll who closely monitor technological change, fashion, and consumption patterns in detail (The New Day, 01-10-2006).
